articles.full_text:
Jharkhand: ESL Steel Limited to launch independent probe after gas exposure kills two
Two people, a company executive and a partner firm's engineer, died after a gas exposure incident at ESL Steel Limited's plant in Bokaro, Jharkhand. The company expressed condolences, pledged support to the families and announced an independent investigation into the incident
Representational image. File pic
Two people have died after a gas exposure incident at ESL Steel Limited plant premises in Jharkhand Bokaro district.
According to the company's statement, a company executive and an engineer associated with a business partner lost their lives.
